revision_summary: One quote timestamp needs correction: the coaching_focus[0] quote ('I I think it depends on...get you completely away from them') is real but occurs around 05:56-06:10, not 05:44 — 05:44 is actually the customer's question that prompts this response. Fix the ts. (3) Flag the diarization ambiguity around 06:11-06:23 (lines attributing 'No. I want to stay connected to them.' to 'rep' when context clearly indicates customer speech) before building state-change and knowledge-gap claims on top of it — note the uncertainty rather than asserting a clean rep-trails-off narrative. (4) Soften interest_reason_audit reasoning: the scam-anxiety topic was customer-initiated in the same breath as the bill-pain disclosure, not a separate pivot imposed by the rep. (5) Correct the customer_demographics schema citation in cherry_pick_moments[0] — trees/sun-exposure observation doesn't belong there. (6) Consider adding missed context signals: the 'we live in a barn' detail (potential text-followup personalization) and the parents' existing Solar Farm land-lease contract (comparative context per verify.prior_designs).
